notes.title: Patch update 1.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

We've made some small bug fixes that we recently pushed out and wanted to give our players a quick overview of what those updates are. Big thank you to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/cg75GduRAG]Discord[/url] community for pointing them out and helping us make sure they get resolved. 

[b][u]Bug Fixes:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Upon completing all of the other achievements, the "Profane" achievement allowing you to officially 100% the game wasn't activating. This should be fixed now allowing for 100% completion! 
[*] The Retry blessing in challenge mode had decided you weren't worthy of another try. We've fixed this and the retry blessing should now allow you to give it another go. 
[*] Mobus decided he had regenerative abilities and once you defeated his first phase, parts of his middle segments would come back to life when you had moved on to attacking just his tail. We worked on Mobus and he will no longer do this.
[*] The "Radiant Flux" active camera was doing some weird shifting. We've also fixed this so there should be no more shifty things. 
[/list]

notes.title: Launch Day Updates
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Firstly, thank you all so much for your support throughout the journey of this game. It's been a bumpy ride but we finally made it to launch! 

Now that we've launched, we've made a couple updates we want everyone to be aware of:
[list]
[*] Mobus had decided that you were too strong to battle, so after phase 2, he would just disappear, making him unbeatable. We've got him working again and ready to take you on for the whole fight. 
[*] We had a player reach out to use about being a disabled gamer and requested a way to move the cursor inside and outside of the game window. We added this to the game and by pressing M on the keyboard, you unlock the "SashaZenko mode." In this mode you can see the cursor all of the time. If you want to turn it back off, just hit M again.
[*] Ultrawide screen (21:9) support - Ultrawide screens for ultrawide bosses
[*] In some localizations, we noticed some loading screen texts were getting cut off by the screen. Now you should be able to read all of the loading screen texts in whatever localization you're playing in. 
[*] Some achievements weren't unlocking upon completion. Now all achievements should be achievable!
[/list]

Again thank you for the support. If you want to talk with the community or report bugs a bit faster, definitely join our [url=https://discord.gg/cg75GduRAG]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Hotfix - Mobus (4th Boss)
notes.content:
We found a bug where Mobus (the 4th boss) doesn't appear in the second phase, but it is now fixed!

Please update the game and try to beat it!
